_comment: Tessera units that have (or will have) a CIP-26 token registry entry. A unit is added when its policy is deployed: sTSRA when the vault is. scripts/build-token-registry.mjs writes <subject>.json bodies from src/config/brand.ts; scripts/verify-token-registry.mjs fails CI when a committed body differs. The bodies are UNSIGNED; the signature is made offline with the dedicated metadata key and is not in this repository.

submission.status: submitted, not yet accepted or wallet-verified
submission.note: submittedValues were read from the PR diff on 2026-10-23 (no logo, no signatures here). The committed body must equal them.
